name: iac
description: Infrastructure as code (Terraform): the plan diff is the specification; apply is always a human decision.

rubric.functionality: The resources added, changed or destroyed match the contract. A replace or destroy of a stateful resource (databases, state backends, DNS) that the contract does not name is a blocking REGRESSION finding.
rubric.quality: Follows the repository's module and environment layout; variables typed and described; no hard-coded account ids, regions or credentials.
rubric.security: Least-privilege IAM, no public exposure the contract does not ask for, encryption at rest and in transit, configured policy scanners (tflint, trivy, checkov) pass.
rubric.errors: Lifecycle guards (prevent_destroy, create_before_destroy) where a replace would cause downtime; dependencies and outputs explicit.
rubric.tests: fmt, validate and configured policy scans pass. terraform plan needs cloud credentials, which verify does not pass through (SR-2), so the plan is reviewed with the plan-review skill before apply instead of being run here.
